ablation.notes: Variant F plus deterministic rank-stratified target queue sampling. Keeps the same internal VAE-latent pairing cache and easy-to-hard active top-k schedule, but reduces per-batch target-hardness jitter. No DINO, CLIP supervision, classifier, or external semantic features.
